origin_note: Candidate family generated by scripts/name-pipeline from the pinned English Wiktionary entry Cameron and the entries that point to it. Every form is justified by that entry's translation table or by a {{given name}} parameter (eq=, dimof=, varof=) on the form's own pinned entry; a similar spelling alone never adds a form.
meaning_note: Do not collapse local full-name equivalents, borrowed spellings, transliterations, or short/pet forms. Character localization and user-name localization require their own policy/consent layer. This family says what the pinned sources list; it is not a promise that every bearer shares one name meaning.

equivalence_sets.note: Full-name forms and equivalents the sources give for both genders. Short and pet forms are intentionally kept in separate equivalence sets.

forms.note: Listed in the pinned Cameron translation table; the form's own entry has no given-name sense in this language, so only the root entry supports it.
